title: Increasing ideal-power annihilator subsheaves and their quotient on a unit open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\iota:\mathcal I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $\mathcal I$ quasi-coherent and of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $P_n=\mathcal I^n$ with inclusion $j_n:P_n\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ and $P_0=\mathcal O_X$, using the recursive ideal powers of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Let $\mathcal F$ be quasi-coherent and $U$ an open such that every $j_n(W)$ is bijective for $W\subseteq U$. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ and any open $W$, say a section $s\in\mathcal F(W)$ is annihilated by $P_n$ if for every open $W\prime\subseteq W$ and every $b\in P_n(W\prime)$, the product $j_n(b)s|_{W\prime}$ is zero. There exist modules $A_n$ and monomorphisms $a_n:A_n\to\mathcal F$, with $A_n$ quasi-coherent and image on each open exactly the sections annihilated by $P_n$. For $n\le m$ there is $t:A_n\to A_m$ with $a_m t=a_n$. For every $W\subseteq U$, $A_n(W)=0$. The cokernel projection $\pi_n:\mathcal F\to\operatorname{coker}(a_n)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] restricts to an isomorphism on $U$ and induces a bijection on sections on every $W\subseteq U$.

proof.text: Construct idealAnnihilatorSections as the submodule of sections killed by every ideal-power section on every smaller open, and idealAnnihilatorPresheaf using restriction. Prove gluing by separatedness of F after intersecting with the gluing cover; naturality of the power inclusion restricts each ideal section. Use ideal_power_annihilator_quasicoherent for quasi-coherence. The inclusion is sectionwise a subtype inclusion, hence mono, and its image is the defining local annihilation condition.

Prove directly by induction on n ≤ m that the annihilator submodule presheaves are increasing. The reflexive case is reflexivity of inclusion. In each successor step, precompose the annihilation test section by the map from power m+1 to power m: ι for m=0, and idealModuleProductι for m>0. The recursive power definition identifies the resulting scalar with the higher-power scalar. Transitivity gives the desired submodule inclusion; homOfLE gives the required morphism. On W contained in U, lift 1 through the power inclusion. The annihilation equation on W forces every section of A_n to be zero. No general power-factor existence theorem is introduced or used.

Every stalk of A_n at a point of U vanishes: represent a germ, intersect its representative open with U, and use the sectionwise vanishing. Stalk exactness identifies the kernel of the cokernel projection with the image of this zero stalk, and also makes the projection surjective. Therefore the projection is bijective on stalks over any W contained in U; sheaf stalk detection gives bijectivity on W. The map under overFunctor is consequently sectionwise bijective, hence mono and epi as a presheaf-module map, hence an isomorphism; the forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem ideal_power_annihilator_system {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules} (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι] [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.Opens) (hbij : ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U → Function.Bijective ((idealSheafPower ι n).2.app W)) : ∃ (A : ℕ → X.Modules) (a : ∀ n : ℕ, A n ⟶ F), (∀ n : ℕ, Mono (a n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (A n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (s : Γ(F, W)), s ∈ Set.range ((a n).app W) ↔ ∀ (W' : X.Opens) (h : W' ≤ W) (b : Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, W')), (F.smul (U := W') ((idealSheafPower ι n).2.val.app (op W') b)).hom (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) = 0) ∧ (∀ (n m : ℕ), n ≤ m → ∃ t : A n ⟶ A m, t ≫ a m = a n) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U → Subsingleton Γ(A n, W)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map (cokernel.π (a n)))) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U → Function.Bijective ((cokernel.π (a n)).app W))
